title: RO faucet produces no water
shortDescription: ROES-50 system fails to deliver any flow at the dedicated faucet.
fullDescription: APEC RO systems run on line pressure. If the feed valve, pre-filter inlet, or shut-off valve is blocked the storage tank cannot fill and the faucet stays dry.

fixSteps.title: Open feed valve
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm the saddle valve under the sink is fully open.

fixSteps.title: Open tank valve
fixSteps.instruction: Turn the blue ball-valve handle on top of the storage tank.

videoSearchQuery: APEC RO no water at faucet

faq.a: Yes - a full tank is about 30 pounds.

title: Slow flow from RO faucet
shortDescription: Storage tank air pressure too low or membrane fouled.
fullDescription: RO storage tanks need 5-7 psi of air pre-charge with the tank empty. Loss of air pressure is the most common cause of slow flow. Recharge the tank with a bicycle pump.
symptoms: Faucet flow drops to trickle quickly

fixSteps.title: Drain and recharge
fixSteps.instruction: Close tank valve, drain via faucet, set air to 7 psi with tank empty.

fixSteps.title: Replace post-filter
fixSteps.instruction: Twist out the inline coconut shell carbon and install a new one.

whenToCallPro: If membrane needs replacement on rare models.

faq.a: Above 10 psi will rupture the bladder.

title: TDS reading above 50 ppm at faucet
shortDescription: Membrane no longer rejecting solids effectively.
fullDescription: A new RO membrane should reject 90%+ of inlet TDS. If TDS at the faucet exceeds half of the inlet TDS for several days, the membrane is fouled or damaged.

fixSteps.title: Replace membrane
fixSteps.instruction: Twist out membrane housing cap, swap membrane every 2-4 years.

faq.a: Less than 50 ppm at the RO faucet.

title: John Guest quick-connect leaking
shortDescription: Tubing not fully inserted into the John Guest fitting.
fullDescription: The 1/4 inch quick-connect fittings need the tube pushed in past two stops. If only past the first stop the collet does not bite and water seeps. Push tube in another 1/4 inch.

fixSteps.title: Reseat tube
fixSteps.instruction: Press down on collet, pull tube out, recut square, push in firmly to second stop.

title: Continuous hiss at drain saddle
shortDescription: Auto-shutoff valve failed - membrane producing constantly.
fullDescription: The ASOV stops production once the storage tank reaches about 2/3 of inlet pressure. If it fails open, the RO runs to drain non-stop. Replace the ASOV assembly.

fixSteps.title: Replace ASOV
fixSteps.instruction: Shut feed, disconnect 4 tubes from ASOV, install new valve in same orientation.

faq.a: Brief noise during fill yes - constant noise no.

title: Air sputter from new install
shortDescription: Air trapped in storage tank or membrane housing.
fullDescription: After install, air remains in lines and tank. The faucet sputters until the system has been drained 2-3 times. This is normal startup behavior.

fixSteps.title: Drain tank
fixSteps.instruction: Open RO faucet for 10 minutes to flush, then refill, repeat 3 times.

title: Plastic or stale taste at faucet
shortDescription: Stagnant water in tank or expired post-filter.
fullDescription: If the system sits unused for a week, water stagnates. Drain the full tank to refresh. If taste persists, replace the inline coconut carbon post-filter.

fixSteps.title: Drain tank
fixSteps.instruction: Open the faucet until tank is empty, refill.

fixSteps.title: Change post-filter
fixSteps.instruction: Annual replacement of the inline carbon.

faq.a: Drain on return after a week away.

title: Storage tank seam leaking
shortDescription: Tank bladder ruptured or seam corroded.
fullDescription: Storage tanks are steel with an internal butyl bladder. Over 10+ years bladders fail or seams rust. Tank must be replaced - they are not repairable.

fixSteps.title: Replace tank
fixSteps.instruction: Shut feed, disconnect tank, screw on new tank with Teflon at threaded port only.

title: White cloudy water clears in glass
shortDescription: Microbubbles trapped in newly produced water.
fullDescription: After a filter change or long idle, RO water may appear cloudy. Pour into a glass - if the cloud clears bottom-up within a minute, it is harmless air, not contamination.

title: Loud gurgle at drain after each draw
shortDescription: Drain saddle installed below the disposal trap.
fullDescription: If the drain saddle is installed below or downstream of the disposal trap arm, water vapor and air get trapped, causing a loud gurgle. Move the saddle upstream of the trap, on the horizontal section.

fixSteps.title: Reposition saddle
fixSteps.instruction: Drill a new hole on the horizontal arm above the trap, swap saddle, plug old hole with rubber grommet.

faq.a: Yes - 6 inches min from trap arm.
